intent: Find where a room is located.
actions: Start signed in as an administrator on the Locations list, with a company location, a building and a room linked in that parent-to-child order.
Open that room from the list and wait for its detail page to load; inspect the breadcrumb and Parent panel.
Click the parent building in the Parent panel and wait for its detail page to load.
Use browser Back to return to the same room and inspect its breadcrumb and Parent panel again.
